name: SlicingBlockRenderer
aliases: Slice-based direct volume renderer with subvolume blocking
definition: A slice-based direct volume rendering method that organizes volume data into subvolumes (blocks) and renders them as textured quads (slices) sorted by distance from the camera to handle transparency correctly.
summary: SlicingBlockRenderer is a slice-based direct volume renderer that partitions data into subvolumes to improve memory locality and culling efficiency.
